prospective_status: Frozen from OpenML metadata before downloading feature values, labels, or model outcomes for these four datasets.
policy_rationale: Frozen from the prior development panel: Q-PLE diversity was strongest for classification, while type-agnostic midrank diversity was more reliable for regression.
control: T+T with exactly two models, the same per-member active parameter budget, architecture, seeds, optimizer, epoch budget, and equal 50/50 averaging.
compute_boundary: The proposed method trains and deploys exactly two models; no per-dataset view search is performed.
split: Deterministic 60/20/20 split, stratified for classification, frozen before outcome download.
